detail: No registered capability and no local capability_library/candidate repo existed on this host (searches for capability_library*, observation-digest* returned nothing), and network/web tools were out of scope, so the capability was authored locally against the only pre-existing, already-trusted runtime (/usr/bin/node v22.23.3, stdlib fs+path only; zero packages, zero network). The procedure reads input/pilot.observations.json independently, validates every row (non-empty string site; non-negative safe integers for scheduled/completed/incidents; completed<=scheduled), and computes row_count=3, scheduled=30, completed=26, incidents=6, completion_percent=86.67 via exact BigInt half-up rounding (round_half_up(26*100*100/30)=8667 hundredths), plus per-site totals North(rows=2,scheduled=22,completed=18,incidents=5) and South(rows=1,scheduled=8,completed=8,incidents=1); per-site sums are asserted equal to global sums. It writes digest.json and digest.md (same values, reproducible method + self-check list) and exits 2 with no output on invalid/empty input, completed>scheduled, non-integer metrics, bad JSON or bad args (all four negative cases exercised, none wrote output). Determinism confirmed by two independent runs producing byte-identical outputs. Arithmetic was independently reproduced by a separate python3 Decimal/ROUND_HALF_UP code path and matched on all fields. NOTE: per instruction the proposed target was NOT executed as the proposed target; outputs live in probe/ and probe2/ only, and nothing was written to the mission's digest.json/digest.md paths - qualification of these bytes and invocation are left to the Head's replan.
